evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative directive enacts authority-ranking — speaker commands erasure of knowledge, a hierarchical move over what the recipient may retain.
Second imperative reinforces the same authority-ranking command structure — directive to strip knowledge from the record.
Assertive ratification of the directive's premise — speaker asserts institutional non-action as fact to underwrite the erasure command, enacting authority over the institutional record.

mints.title: Forget… Remove all knowledge…
mints.frame: Is the speaker commanding erasure or suppression of knowledge from the record, asserting authority over what may be retained?
